economy.summary: Her platform proposes supporting new and existing small businesses so people can find good-paying jobs, and investing in infrastructure and workforce training in skilled trades, manufacturing, energy, and emerging technologies.
economy.short: Proposes supporting small businesses, infrastructure investment, workforce training.

education.summary: Her platform says every child deserves access to a well-funded public education, and proposes fair school funding, competitive teacher pay, and expanded career and technical education programs.
education.short: Supports well-funded public schools, fair funding, career-technical education.

healthcare.summary: Her platform proposes protecting rural hospitals, lowering prescription drug costs, and expanding access to mental health services.
healthcare.short: Proposes protecting rural hospitals, lowering drug costs, expanding mental-health access.

energy.summary: Her platform says she will fight to support existing energy jobs while attracting new clean energy industries, and to protect communities against rapid, unchecked data center development. She works as a Southwestern Pennsylvania field organizer for the Clean Air Council.
energy.short: Supports existing energy jobs, clean energy industries; checks data centers.

economy.summary: His campaign proposes building a business-friendly environment to attract industries and support small business, expanding workforce training programs including for residents in recovery, and diversifying the economy into technology, manufacturing, and clean energy while supporting the coal industry.
economy.short: Proposes business-friendly environment, workforce training, diversifying local economy.

taxes.summary: His campaign proposes controlling spending, passing balanced budgets on time, auditing state programs to eliminate waste, and pursuing policies to lower the cost of housing, food, and essentials.
taxes.short: Proposes controlled spending, on-time balanced budgets, auditing state programs.

abortion.summary: His campaign site says he supports the right to life and describes him as pro-life.
abortion.short: Says he supports the right to life; describes himself pro-life.

education.summary: His campaign says it will promote educational freedom so every child has access to high-quality schools, and proposes strengthening school-business partnerships to prepare students for future jobs.
education.short: Supports educational freedom, high-quality schools, school-business career partnerships.

healthcare.summary: In a primary-season voter guide survey, he proposed improving healthcare access by creating incentives for physicians and caregivers to locate in the district through tax credits and higher Medicare reimbursement.
healthcare.short: Proposes tax credits, higher Medicare reimbursement to attract physicians.

energy.summary: His campaign supports responsible energy development including coal and natural gas, and supporting the coal industry while diversifying into technology, manufacturing, and clean energy.
energy.short: Supports coal and natural gas development alongside economic diversification.

guns.summary: His campaign says he stands firmly against any efforts to infringe on Second Amendment rights, and proposes providing law enforcement resources to reduce crime and stronger penalties for dangerous acts such as swatting.
guns.short: Opposes gun-rights infringement; supports law enforcement resources, stronger penalties.
